import itertools
import networkx as nx
import random

def get_d2_pairs(G):
    n = G.number_of_nodes()
    count = 0
    for u, v in itertools.combinations(range(n), 2):
        if not G.has_edge(u, v):
            if any(G.has_edge(u, w) and G.has_edge(v, w) for w in range(n)):
                count += 1
    return count

def test_structures(n):
    max_d2 = 0
    
    # Star graph
    G_star = nx.star_graph(n-1)
    max_d2 = max(max_d2, get_d2_pairs(G_star))
    
    # Complete bipartite
    for m in range(1, n // 2 + 1):
        G_bip = nx.complete_bipartite_graph(m, n-m)
        max_d2 = max(max_d2, get_d2_pairs(G_bip))
        
    # Random graphs
    for _ in range(1000):
        p = random.random()
        G_rand = nx.fast_gnp_random_graph(n, p)
        max_d2 = max(max_d2, get_d2_pairs(G_rand))
        
    return max_d2

for n in range(6, 11):
    print(f"n={n}, max_d2={test_structures(n)}")
